title: The Detention of the quarry
author: Felix Nakamura
blurb: Tamsin Galloway, the new kid at a school built over something old, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
